name: 33432 · Boca Raton, FL
findings: ZIP 33432 (Boca Raton) has 243 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33432 (Boca Raton) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
61% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 46 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
